caption:
The blows keep coming. It feels like you're being discarded — but the forge only heats what it means to make. (Galatians 3:3 devotional)

Having begun by the Spirit, you can't be perfected by the flesh — and the hammer isn't rejection, it's forming. God is the Blacksmith shaping you into a work He has already promised to complete, and the fire only touches what He intends to make. The One who began a good work in you will bring it to completion.
